name: Youth Motive
source:
A rooftop becomes their shared world: one quiet enough for secrets, soft enough for something new to grow...

[From [url=https://tytywithasword.itch.io/youth-motive]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一处天台成了独属于两人的小小世界：这里足够静谧，容得下心底的秘密；也足够温柔，能让某种全新的情愫悄然萌芽……

[摘自[url=https://tytywithasword.itch.io/youth-motive]itch.io[/url]]
